name: company-overview-from-website
description: Produce the company-overview markdown that the investor-portal generator reads: what a listed company does, who leads it, what it has lodged, and every image and PDF it publishes — crawled from the company's own site so every fact is attributable rather than authored. Pairs with design-md-from-website to form the two inputs generate-investor-portal requires. Carries the output contract the generator parses, including the exclusions (privacy policies, crawler scaffolding, cart and login pages) that have silently become fake business units on real runs.
